title: Delayed ingestion
purpose: Keep source observation time separate from backend ingestion delay.

expected.semantic_interpretation: The event was observed promptly but reached the foundation a day later.
expected.observability: Ingestion delay does not change occurrence semantics.
expected.opportunity: No opportunity claim is required for this fixture.
expected.time: Ingestion is one day after result time and must not replace phenomenon ordering.
expected.provenance: Source identity and capture/procedure provenance remain explicit.
expected.raw_derived: Evidence kind is explicit and does not imply a pattern.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer a routine, preference, habit, or pattern conclusion.
